rules.statement: A surety who discharges the principal obligation is entitled to stand in the shoes of that creditor, and to enforce all the rights available to that creditor.
rules.supporting_quote: "It appears from 2 Nathan 1035 that the Roman-Dutch law is that a surety who discharges the principal obligation is entitled to stand in the shoes of the original creditor, and to enforce all the rights available to that creditor"
